name: How Many Coats of Finish Does a Hardwood Floor Actually Need
title-tag: How Many Coats of Finish Does a Hardwood Floor Need?
meta-description: Three coats — a sealer plus two topcoats — is right for most floors. When two is enough, when four is worth it, and why the product matters more than the count.
post-summary: February 17, 2027 · Three coats of waterborne finish — sealer plus two topcoats — is the residential standard, and coat count is the easiest number in the trade to inflate. What a coat actually is, where two or four make sense, why abrasion between coats matters, and how to read a quote that promises more.
